name: ActiveIncidentsCard
description: Summary card displaying a list of active incidents/alerts with severity indicators, loading skeleton, and empty state. Rows are virtualized via `@tanstack/react-virtual` so the card stays responsive…
descriptionFull: Summary card displaying a list of active incidents/alerts with severity indicators, loading skeleton, and empty state. Rows are virtualized via `@tanstack/react-virtual` so the card stays responsive with thousands of incidents

props.name: label
props.description: Header label shown above the list

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Show skeleton rows instead of items

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class names appended to the root

props.name: skeletonRows
props.description: Number of skeleton rows shown when `isLoading`

props.name: onItemClick
props.description: Called with the incident id when a row is clicked

fields.name: id
fields.description: Incident identifier; the virtual-list row key and the argument passed to the click handler

fields.name: body
fields.description: Third line of the row, under `subtitle`

fields.name: subtitle
fields.description: Second line of the row, under `title`

fields.name: severity
fields.description: `critical`, `high` or `medium`; sets the colored severity dot beside the row

fields.name: onClick
fields.description: Row click handler, called with `id`; in `ActiveIncidentsCard` it is always replaced by `onItemClick`
